As the TV series tracking app TV Time ceased operations last month, one of its co-founders, Antonio Pinto, announced the launch of a brand-new series and movie tracking app called Bingers, which focuses on richer social features. Here are the details.

Bingers is now available for download

Whip Media, the company behind the series tracking app TV Time, previously announced that it would be shutting down. One of the app's co-founders immediately announced the launch of Bingers, positioning it as a "watchlist with speed, beauty, and fun community features."

According to TechCrunch, Bingers is now available for download on iOS and Android platforms, providing a spiritual continuation of sorts for users who have yet to find a replacement. TV Time was once one of the most widely used TV tracking apps in the world.

Users who previously used TV Time and have saved their data through the platform's export tool before the app was shut down can import their archived records into Bingers, seamlessly continuing their original experience. Users who have not exported their data, or new users using a tracking app for the first time, can start from scratch.

Bingers significantly enhances its community-driven features, including user profiles, comments, series ratings, GIFs, polls, and character popularity rankings. Pinto told TechCrunch that these features are precisely what made TV Time so popular over the years:

For users who simply want to track the series and movies they have watched, Bingers offers a dedicated watchlist and viewing history. Similar to TV Time, it also displays a calendar of upcoming series and premiere dates, indicating how many days remain until release.

Bingers is available for free download on the App Store, and currently does not offer any in-app purchases.
